ejaculate: To eject abruptly; to throw out suddenly and swiftly.
ejaculated: simple past and past participle of ejaculate
ejaculates: third-person singular simple present indicative of ejaculate
ejaculating: present participle and gerund of ejaculate
ejaculation: The act of ejecting or suddenly throwing fluid or some other substance from a duct or other body structure.
ejaculator: A person or thing that ejaculates.
eject: To compel (a person or persons) to leave.
ejecta: Material which has been ejected, especially from a volcano or an impact crater.
ejected: simple past and past participle of eject
ejecting: present participle and gerund of eject
ejective: Serving to eject, or characterised by ejection.
ejectment: The legal process of ejecting someone from their property or holdings.
ejector: One who, or that which, ejects or dispossesses.
ejects: third-person singular simple present indicative of eject
